messages.author: 84e0e4bc8c0ec55c
messages.subject: Wav file time & date
parts:
Hi Vincent/all, 

Firstly thank you for creating and continually updating such an extensive package for analysis of accelerometer files. I have been using version 1.5-3 to analyse some .wav files from an Axivity device with primarily successful results. However the time stamp is always 2106-02-07 06:28:15.000 on each file regardless of the real time the recording started/ended, desiredtz setting, dayborder, etc. I know exactly the start/end time, is there a way to manually input the start and finish time point to GGIR?

Regards, 

Lewis

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Wav file time & date
parts:
Hi Lewis,
I am aware of this possible issue in .wav data. I have addressed the issue for wav data from some research groups, but a generic solution that works for everyone is still missing I am afraid. The underlying problem may be the OMGUI software or Axivity firmware. My advise would be to start using cwa format data from now onwards.

Regards, Vincent
